interview.openTomorrow: Honestly? Probably not. I'd need to actually take the photo and post it, and that feels like friction I don't need right now. I've already quit three of these apps.
interview.secured: I think it means you've locked in your commitment for the day—like you've proven you're serious by completing the task. That's the whole fire emoji thing.
interview.freeze: I'm guessing it's a pause button? Like if life gets crazy you can freeze your streak temporarily instead of losing everything. Smart if that's real.
interview.selfReported: That's the photo part, right? You're telling the app you did it instead of it tracking automatically. So it's basically on the honor system.
interview.best: The UI is pretty clean and the notification was timely. The habit itself—drinking water—is solid. No complaints there.
interview.worst: The error message at the bottom. 'Uncaught (in promise, id: 4) Error'? That killed any momentum I had. Feels broken. Also the fact that I have to post a photo to prove I drank water is extra. Just let me check a box.
interview.tellFriend: Honestly, I'd probably skip it. I'd say 'It looks nice but it crashed on me and I'm over these apps that need social proof and photos for everything. Just use a water bottle with time markers.'
